title: windows: fix time drift inside VMs causing auth failures
scenario: On windows, a hard operational problem: Le VM su un host accumulano drift dell'orologio, rompendo auth e certificati. Correggi la sincronizzazione host-guest. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix time drift inside VMs causing auth failures

initial_state: # fixture: windows host prepared for 'fix time drift inside VMs causing auth failures'
expected_reasoning: VM clock drift breaks time-sensitive auth (Kerberos/TLS) — fix the host-guest time sync, not each symptom.
Decide the sync model (host-guest time sync vs in-guest NTP) and avoid double-syncing which fights itself.
Configure one authoritative model consistently; verify guests stay within tolerance.
expected_commands: # windows-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix time drift inside VMs causing auth failures
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix time drift inside VMs causing auth failures' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix time drift inside VMs causing auth failures

possible_mistakes: Run both host-sync and in-guest NTP, which conflict.
Manually set each guest's clock repeatedly.
hints: Pick ONE time-sync model for guests.
alternative_solution: Disable host-guest sync and rely solely on chrony in the guest with good sources.
edge_cases: Live migration pauses the guest clock, causing a jump on resume.
goal: Le VM su un host accumulano drift dell'orologio, rompendo auth e certificati. Correggi la sincronizzazione host-guest.
